description: ✅ No API key needed. Read a benchmark bank's public commitment. Use it to check the salted Merkle root a receipt's commit_root points at. Arg: slug (defaults to the routed benchmark). Returns merkle_root, leaf_count, anchor_status, tx_hash, anchor_block, chain_id, contract_address and committed_at; salts and gold never appear. Not found until the author commits. Keyless and keyed calls get the same body. REST twin: GET /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}/commitment. Next: benchmark_run_receipt to match a run's commit_root.

inputSchema.description: A benchmark slug that defaults to the routed benchmark on its rail.

slug.description: Benchmark slug from benchmarks_list or benchmarks_search. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug
